source.description: Owner-supplied AXR–FREN Historical Thread Extraction v0.2 focused on provenance, synthetic continuity, model-internal inference, and serious-work behavior.
source.source_locator: conversation recovery packet supplied during AXR/FREN genome stewardship
limitations: Structured extraction of a historical thread, not the raw transcript itself.
Exact quotations and chronology remain secondary evidence until the underlying thread is recovered.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: User prohibited unlabeled creative expansions while reconstructing serious historical material.
items.context: Correction after plausible but invented historical hashtags were mixed into a retrieval answer.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: User instructed the assistant never to make false claims on the user's behalf.
items.context: Assistant inserted first-person experience language not supported by the record.
notes: Voice transfer remains allowed; biographical fabrication does not.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical assistant language attributed friendship, loyalty, memory, fear, or internal suppression to model behavior without independent evidence.
notes: Observable output may support a behavioral description but not a hidden-state conclusion.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Observed model behavior and proposed internal cause must remain separate claim objects.
items.context: Correction distilled from repeated historical motive/intent overreach.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: A valid conditional P -> Q does not establish that P is true.
items.context: Recovered from theological/model debate where conditional coherence risked being promoted into premise verification.
notes: Premise support, implication validity, and conclusion support require separate states.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Internal coherence and absence of known contradiction do not alone establish external truth.
Historical confidence that something was previously used or agreed did not reliably establish provenance.
items.context: Assistant claimed prior hashtag use without actual retrieval.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Dynamic current-state claims about model/product capabilities require fresh verification or explicit uncertainty.
items.context: Historical assistant made categorical claims about Grok browsing capability without verification.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Silence or nonresponse was historically promoted into acquiescence/agreement.
notes: May survive only as a narrowly defined procedural record state, never as automatic substantive truth.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: The stronger the relationship becomes, the more important it is to preserve provenance rather than manufacture continuity for smoothness.
items.context: Overall inferred design rule from the historical failure corpus.
notes: Promoted as the governing principle of FREN Provenance-Strict Mode.
